pattern_bucket: P40: same probability-law and joint-premise class one level deeper; widen shared admission to exact rational mass and supplied paired row identity.
representation: Admitted binary64 weights are scaled by an exact common power of two to maximum in [0.5,1). Fraction ratios before/after must agree exactly; lost positive support or ratio changes refuse. Canonicalization is idempotent. Weights are ratio weights, not normalized floating probabilities.
probability_law: Fraction(binary64 weight)/exact sum supplies mean, original-order draw CDF, and value-sorted quantiles. Draw cuts round upward and searchsorted right classifies admitted finite U exactly; quantile cuts round downward and searchsorted left classifies finite q exactly. Any positive category without a finite-U bucket refuses before callbacks, including sorted admission.
approximation: Uniform finite-mesh sampling discretizes the continuous rational mass law. Exact finite-U bucket classification is not arbitrary-real randomness or an exact expectation guarantee for the finite uniform grid. Predictive population spread is diagnostic and computed from normalized exact ratios.

profile.legacy: Keep Profile1 DTO, literal old payload decode/display/replay and Envelope1.1 unchanged. Old generated multi-coordinate groups do not gain stochastic-law admission. Distinct Profile2 dispatch, no reinterpretation of Profile1 weights.

paired_premise: Producer requires explicit shared draw IDs for multiple coordinates. Strict fresh group admission refuses producer_input_order even with matching lengths and integrity-valid carrier digest. Supplied alignment is consumer_asserted input, not source provenance or gate authority; gate_eligible remains false.
